description.content:
# Aquabyte Public API

To use our API you must be issued an API key.

Instructions: For all HTTPS requests you will need to pass in your API key as part of the header:
`apikey: {API_KEY}`

Our base url is https://api.aquabyte.ai/v3/

Requests are limited to 1000 requests/hour


# What's new in v3.1

With v3.1, we have added new APIs to support bulk fetching. One of the
main use case is for users to download Aquabyte data into their own database.
The new API allows us to download all pens with available data in a single call.
For example, to fetch biomass data for all pens, you can use the following API call:

```
GET "https://api.aquabyte.ai/v3/biomass?penId=all&fromDate=2026-01-01&toDate=2026-01-02"
```

You can switch to v3.1 API simply by changing the URL from this pattern
`GET /pens/{penId}/biomass` to this pattern `GET /biomass?penId={penId}`. Similar
pattern is used for other data - environmental, lice, welfare and behaviour.

Since v3.1 supports everything in v3.0. We recommend switching to v3.1 as soon as possible.
v3.0 support continues during the transition.


## Result pagination

Currently, Aquabyte Public API caps the result set up to 10,000 records.
If the result set has more data than the limit, they will be returned in batches.
In this case, the response will contain a "nextToken". For example:

```
GET "https://api.aquabyte.ai/v3/biomass?penId=all&fromDate=2025-01-01&toDate=2025-12-31"


It returns

{
  "biomass": [
    ... up to limit number of records ...
  ]
  "nextToken": "(A_TOKEN)"
}
```

To fetch the next batch of data, repeat the request and add the "nextToken" to the query parameters.

```
GET "https://api.aquabyte.ai/v3/biomass?penId=all&fromDate=2025-01-01&toDate=2025-12-31&nextToken=(A_TOKEN)"
```

Repeating the request until "nextToken" is not present in the response.
This indicates that you have fetched all data.
